description: Elections Commission - Mr. S. C. Muthukumarana has been declared elected as a member of the Ninth Parliament for the Electoral District No. 17, Anuradhapura to fill the Vacancy caused by reason of the resignation of Mr. Uddika Premarathna
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically addresses the filling of a parliamentary vacancy due to a resignation and the declaration of a new Member of Parliament for an electoral district. It involves electoral processes, including the notification of a vacancy, the direction to fill it, and the declaration of election results - all core functions of an election commission related to parliamentary elections. This fits squarely within the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral processes, candidate registrations, election results, and declarations.
